name: world.catalog

name: world.link_card
description: Voluntarily bind one of your bank cards to your payment wallet. Choose a bank from payment.banks and a full card number from bank.cards. Completes your bank login, mailbox OTP and card-specific consent. Returns a masked card and source ID for payment.card_payment. No borrowing or prebinding.
